name: Sparks Lake Surrounding Dispersed Camping - Deschutes National Forest

management_agency.name: U.S. Forest Service - Bend-Fort Rock Ranger District

rules_and_regulations.stay_limit: 14 consecutive days max stay within 30-day period
rules_and_regulations.guidelines: Dispersed primitive camping permitted only at designated numbered sites along Forest Road 4600-370 corridor. Campers must park within designated site boundary posts. Camping set back 100ft from water.

waste_disposal_rules.poop_disposal: Cathole method: dig 6 inches deep in volcanic ash/pumice soil, at least 200 feet from Sparks Lake and streams. Pack out toilet paper.
waste_disposal_rules.trash_policy: Strict Leave No Trace pack-it-in pack-it-out. Black bear country: hard-sided vehicle or bear canister storage mandatory.

campfire_rules.firewood_policy: Gather dead and downed wood only.
campfire_rules.safety_requirements: Campfires in designated stone/metal fire rings only. Extinguish cold to touch with lake water.
campfire_rules.seasonal_fire_bans: Stage 1 and Stage 2 fire restrictions strictly enforced during dry summer (July-September).

access_and_road_conditions.road_type: Paved highway changing to unpaved volcanic cinder forest road (Cascade Lakes Highway / FR 370)
access_and_road_conditions.road_conditions: Washboard gravel and volcanic cinder road with rocks, dust, and washboards.
access_and_road_conditions.vehicle_recommendation: High clearance car or CUV/SUV recommended (Normal 2WD low clearance cars can access lower sites near paved highway in dry weather)

nomad_connectivity_rating.verizon_reliability: 3-4 bars 5G/LTE (20-50 Mbps download near Century Drive junction)
nomad_connectivity_rating.terrain_obstruction_risk: Low to Moderate (Open volcanic plateau with Mt. Bachelor & South Sister views)

amenities: Panoramic Views of South Sister & Mount Bachelor

seasonal_weather_effects.spring: Late May thaw: cold (40-55°F), high snowmelt runoff, road gates opening around Memorial Day.
seasonal_weather_effects.summer: Ideal Pacific Northwest summer (75-85°F daytime, crisp 40-45°F nights), low humidity, mosquito activity near lake in June.
seasonal_weather_effects.fall: Crisp 55-68°F days, freezing night temperatures (25-35°F), clear starry nights, prime boondocking.
seasonal_weather_effects.winter: Severe Cascade mountain winter (15-30°F), heavy snowpack, Cascade Lakes Highway closed to cars (groomed snowmobile trail).

dangers_and_hazards: Black Bears and Cougars present in Cascades
Volcanic dust storms during dry summer winds

acoustic_environment.quietness_rating: 8/10 - Alpine lake and lodgepole pine quiet
common_human_made_sounds: Paddleboarders and kayakers on Sparks Lake
Occasional vehicle passing on Cascade Lakes Highway

human_demographics_and_culture: Cascade Mountain trail runners, stand-up paddleboarders, Bend digital nomads, landscape photographers, and overlanders.

spiritual_and_folklore_data.nature_spirits_and_mythological_lore: Klamath and Warm Springs indigenous oral traditions honor the Three Sisters volcanic peaks and glacial headwater lakes as sacred emergence homes of the mountain and fire spirits.
spiritual_and_folklore_data.energetic_and_spiritual_features: High volcanic mountain peak energy, crystal-clear glacial lake reflections, 5G-connected alpine sanctuary.

nearby_hiking_trails.trail_name: Ray Atkeson Memorial Loop Trail (Sparks Lake)
nearby_hiking_trails.features: Winding lava rock trail along Sparks Lake shore with iconic reflections of South Sister

public_reviews_summary: World-class Oregon mountain boondocking near Bend. Breathtaking volcanic peak views, pristine water, and fast 5G cell internet.
other_data: Bortle Class 2 night sky. Excellent solar panel efficiency.

nomad_connectivity_rating.overall_rating: Good to Strong / Highway Tower Line

seasonal_weather_effects.fall: 48-68°F, golden aspen colors, crisp chilly starry nights.
seasonal_weather_effects.winter: 15-32°F, heavy Cascade mountain snowpack, snowshoe and cross-country ski season.

name: Alvord Desert Dispersed Area - BLM Burns

management_agency.name: Bureau of Land Management (BLM) - Burns District

rules_and_regulations.stay_limit: 14 days maximum stay within a 28-day window

nomad_connectivity_rating.terrain_obstruction_risk: Low on playa / High under Steens mountain wall shadow
